fields.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
fields.note: Prohibition, definition and civil action by tenant or City Attorney are supported by D081. The penalty amounts ($1,000 per violation, damages, injunctive relief) and the unit-month violation language are not in D081; they come only from the secondary source DX06, which is not in the document provided.

fields.quoted_span: allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law.
fields.note: The ban, nonpublic competitor data, civil action and Oct. 14, 2024 effective date are supported. The $1,000 per violation and each unit-month separate violation are not in D081.
